CustomField.label: Answers JSON
CustomField.description: Offering-agnostic per-question answer blob for submissions scored against the new GTM_Instrument_Definition__c / _Question_Definition__c schema (docs/architecture/gtm-instrument-schema.md). A single JSON object keyed by each question's stable Question_Key__c, e.g. {"q1":"yes","q2":["a","b"]} -- one flat map, not a child record per answer, to avoid row explosion under guest load. This is the generic-path counterpart to the Migration-Accelerator- specific Section_Scores__c / Supplement_Scores__c hybrid; a submission on the new schema never populates Estate_Complexity_*__c or Instrument_Pair__c. Opaque to Apex except for outcome-mapping resolution (sub-issue 03/04).
